description: The simulation uses no patient, variant, gated, or assay-result data.
Authorized local case analysis must select and justify the affected SAC-gene branch before model construction; no public gene assumption is made.
One parental iPSC background with inducible partial depletion of the authorized case-selected gene and its matched non-targeting control, qualified through neural-progenitor differentiation.

Qualification requires concordant deficient-state phenotypes from at least two non-overlapping guides; the vehicle-controlled candidate screen freezes one lead guide without using candidate outcomes, and any apparent pass requires second-guide or orthogonal complementation/rescue confirmation before advancement.
Each fresh initiation/differentiation run is one randomized block and one biological unit; wells, fields, images, and cells are subsamples.

Blinded automated count of terminal-viability-dye-negative MAP2+TUBB3+ cells at differentiation day 21 per 100 viable PAX6+SOX2+ progenitors plated at day 0; qualification must establish marker kinetics and repeatability before freeze.
ATP-linked oxygen-consumption rate after oligomycin response, normalized to the prespecified viable-cell denominator.
TMRM signal normalized to mitochondrial mass under a frozen acquisition and positive-control protocol.
The primary neural endpoint and exactly two mitochondrial support endpoints must each exceed the margin at both locked doses; none is substitutable.
Benefit cannot offset chromosome-error, abnormal-clone persistence, malignant-fitness, invasion, chemotherapy-resistance, viability, or unresolved-safety failure.
Fixed pseudorandom seed; all public sensitivity scenarios reuse common random numbers.
Enough for a maximum binomial Monte Carlo standard error of about 0.0046; increase at design freeze.
All vehicle and locked-dose conditions occur within every complete randomized run.
Common true treatment-minus-vehicle benefit assumed for each of the six co-required endpoint-dose comparisons; not an efficacy estimate.
SD of independent run-level treatment-minus-vehicle differences after averaging technical subsamples.
Illustrative lower-bound margin only; qualification and expert review must calibrate and freeze it before confirmation.
Equicorrelation among the six run-level endpoint-dose differences from a shared run response; pilot covariance must replace it.
Candidate-family error target; not a completed analysis-plan choice.
Bonferroni sensitivity for arimoclomol and elamipretide; intersection-union testing requires all endpoint-dose comparisons for a candidate to pass at alpha 0.025.
All effect and variability values are expressed in the prospectively frozen qualification-control SD, not technical-well SD.
